children: accepted bids worth 10 billion rupees ($104.23 million) for sale of bonds maturing in three years, three bankers said on Thursday.

The company will pay a coupon of 150 basis points over the three-month overnight index swap rate, which currently works out to 6.97%. It had invited commitment bids for the issue on Wednesday, the bankers said.
The firm did not respond to a Reuters email seeking comment.
